payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in speculation detection and scope resolution tasks, including improvements in F1 scores and comparisons between different models.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets.
State-of-the-art results were reported on negation scope resolution for the BioScope Corpus, with increases of 3.16 F1 points on Full Papers and 0.06 F1 points on Abstracts.
